attributes.cond: If the operation ended in an error.

metrics.name: gen_ai.client.operation.time_to_first_chunk
metrics.brief: Time to receive the first chunk, measured from when the client issues the generation request to when the first chunk is received in the response stream.

metrics.name: gen_ai.client.operation.time_per_output_chunk
metrics.brief: Time per output chunk, recorded for each chunk received after the first one, measured as the time elapsed from the end of the previous chunk to the end of the current chunk.

metrics.name: gen_ai.server.request.duration
metrics.brief: Generative AI server request duration such as time-to-last byte or last output token.

metrics.name: gen_ai.server.time_per_output_token
metrics.brief: Time per output token generated after the first token for successful responses.

metrics.name: gen_ai.server.time_to_first_token
metrics.brief: Time to generate first token for successful responses.

metrics.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration
metrics.brief: The end-to-end duration of a single in-process agent invocation, from the moment the invocation starts until the agent emits the last chunk of its final response or terminates with an error.

metrics.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.inference_calls
metrics.brief: The number of inference (model) calls a GenAI agent makes during a single invocation.

metrics.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.tool_calls
metrics.brief: The number of tool calls a GenAI agent makes during a single invocation.

metrics.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.duration
metrics.brief: The duration of a single tool execution.
